faq.q: How do I install Score! Hero on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Score! Hero and check the developer is First Touch Games Ltd. before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from First Touch Games Ltd. and may be altered, so the safest way to play Score! Hero is the official listing.

Yes, Score! Hero is free to download and play. It shows ads and sells optional in-app purchases from $0.99 to $59.99 per item on Google Play, such as extra energy and bucks. Some purchases include random items. You can play through the career without paying, just more slowly.

faq.q: How do you play Score! Hero?
faq.a: You don't control a whole team. Each level is a moment from your player's match, and you swipe a line on the screen to pass the ball between teammates, then draw a curve to shoot. Completing a level's goal, such as scoring or assisting, earns stars and moves your career forward.

Many Score! Hero levels can be played without an internet connection. Online features, such as events, cloud saving of your progress and some rewards, need a connection. Connecting regularly keeps your career backed up if you change phones. Progress made offline is saved on your phone until you reconnect.

Score! Hero is made by First Touch Games Ltd., the UK studio that also makes Dream League Soccer. It's been on Google Play since November 2015, and new seasons of levels are still added regularly; the October 2026 update added Season 63.
